request.subject: The Titanic Stewardess Who Wouldn't Sink - part 3: The Third Sister Ship
request.title: The Titanic Stewardess Who Wouldn't Sink (Part 3/3)
request.description:
Violet Jessop was aboard for a collision, the Titanic and a wartime mine, all on sister ships. Would you ever go back to sea after that?

Part 3 of 3: The Titanic Stewardess Who Wouldn't Sink

Sources:
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Violet_Jessop
https://www.nationalgeographic.com/magazine/article/titanic-woman-survivor-nurse-illness-unsinkable
https://www.history.co.uk/articles/unsinkable-violet-jessop

Stock footage: Pexels. Made with AI-assisted narration.

#shorts #truestory

extra_params.video_script: Violet jumped out of a lifeboat to escape spinning propellers. In Part 2, Violet survived Titanic, holding a stranger's baby in her lifeboat. By 1916, she was a nurse aboard Britannic, Titanic's other sister, now a World War One hospital ship. It struck a German mine in the Aegean Sea and sank in under an hour. As lifeboats launched, the still-turning propellers began pulling them in. Violet jumped into the sea and suffered a serious head injury. She survived that too. Today, she's remembered as unsinkable. Three sister ships, three disasters, and Violet survived every one. Subscribe for a new true story every day.
